title: 第17章 经文与仙塔第18章 进塔
content_zh:
张皓旸听白衣白发白须老者让他称自己为石灵，他感觉不甚合适，似有对石老不尊重之意，于是就说道：“以后我就称你为石老，可否？”
白衣白发白须老者似是看透张皓旸的心思，于是就微笑着点头道：“当然可以！”
“石老，我看到在此空间内还有一仙塔，这仙塔是何来历？”
张皓旸问道。
石老闻言，略微沉思后说道：“此仙塔极为神秘，吾也不知其具体来历，只知在吾受伤陷入沉寂无数岁月后，仙塔突然出现在此空间之内，随仙塔一同出现在此空间的还有一段经文。”
“一段经文，是那段四十字经文吗？”
张皓旸惊讶的问道。
石老略微思忖后答道；“正是当时在你脑海中出现的那一段四十字经文。
吾认为此仙塔与经文应该是一位无上大能将其放入吾空间之内的，吾因为此经文与仙塔的出现才能得以恢复。
当少主滴血获得混沌造化石认可时，那段经文竟是自动进入你的神识之中，显然你也是获得那位无上大能认可之人！”
“是谁有这种能力在悄无声息中将这通天仙塔放入此空间？是谁在石老都无法察觉的时候将经文传授于你？是谁能做到在我滴血认主混沌造化石时再将经文传授给我？这是一位怎样的存在？”
张皓旸诧异的问道。
“此人应该是在神魔大战后出现的无上大能，他绝对是至高无上的存在，就连击伤吾的众魔都无法与其比肩！
石老感叹道。
“石老，那段四十字经文与仙塔如何助你恢复伤势？你的伤势现在又恢复的如何？”
张皓旸关心的问道。
“吾获得那段四十经文后就主动修炼，原本被众魔击中后经无数岁月都无法恢复一丝的伤势在修炼经文后竟是在缓缓得以恢复。
那座仙塔与经文同时出现，经文末尾又有混沌造化文字出现，因此吾就将经文则称为混沌造化诀，仙塔则称为混沌塔。”
“经文的神奇之处，想必这几天你已经感受到！
至于这混沌塔也是极为神奇，混沌塔共分九层，每一层塔内都有无尽宝物，每一层的开启都有条件。

更为神奇的是塔内的时间流速与塔外不同，并且每一层塔塔内的时间流速也都不同，往往是前一层塔塔内时间流速的三倍。
以第一层塔为例，塔内的时间流速是外界的十倍，在里面修炼一天就相当于在外面修炼十天；第二层塔塔内的时间流速是外界的三十倍，第三层塔塔内的时间流逝是外界的九十倍，第四层塔塔内的时间流逝是外界的二百七十倍，依次类推。”
“吾目前在第四层修行，也就是外界一天，在混沌塔四层已经是二百七十天。
因为吾一直在混沌塔第四层运转经文恢复，所以自然就比外界恢复起来要快上许多倍！”
“原来如此！
世间竟有如此宝物？石老刚才说过，混沌塔每层开启都有条件，那具体条件是什么呢？石老也是在修为符合条件后进入混沌塔的吗？张皓旸有些好奇的问道。
“混沌塔的开启条件并不复杂，只是对开启者的修为有要求而已。
混沌塔共分九层，每一层的开启条件都不一样。
第一层需要开启者至少有筑基境修为方能打开；第二层需要开启者至少有元婴境修为方能打开；第三层需要开启者至少有化神境修为方能打开；第四层则需要开启者至少有大乘境修为方能打开。
“吾非人、非魂乃是石灵的存在，因此在进入混沌塔时并未受到修为的限制。
当吾在进入混沌塔一层后就直接被传到第四层；至于前四层的开启条件，吾是如何知道一事？说来有些惭愧，吾并未亲身经历，而是当经文与混沌塔出现在混沌造化空间时，吾的记忆中就出现了这些信息。
能神不知鬼不觉的将这些信息放入吾的记忆，这也正是吾佩服那位无上大能的原因之一。
吾虽能进入混沌塔四层修炼但也只能在混沌塔的第四层进行修炼，前四层的准入条件吾记忆中有，但是对于第五层到第九层的准入条件确实没有记忆，因此吾也并不清楚！”
石老在介绍完混沌塔前四层的开启条件后就停顿下来没有再说，他好似在沉思。
张皓旸见石老的表情就知道他在思考事情于是也就没有打扰他，他静静的等待。
石老在沉思片刻后又接着说道：“按照混沌塔前四层的开启条件，按照吾恢复后的修为情况来看，即使吾的修为只恢复万分之一，也不止只能进入第四层，因此可以得出结论，混沌塔的第五至第九层无法进入必定还有其他不为人知的原因。
至于具体是什么原因？吾在此修炼、分析也有一些岁月，但是却始终无法得出结论！
现在，你既然已经是混沌造化空间的主人，也得到那位无上大能的认可，想必在以后的修行中会有所感悟，使自己真正具备开启后续楼层的条件，在后续楼层中快速提升修为！”
闻言，张皓旸微微点头，
“刚才石老说，那段经文称为混沌造化诀，此功法在我近期的修行中发挥作用极大，助我接连突破，但是我却对此功法知之甚少，也就只是口中默念，此功法自会导引体内真气。

对于此功法的作用还请石老明示！”
当石老听张皓旸向他请教混沌造化诀的作用时，微微点头笑着回答道：“吾修炼混沌造化诀的时间较你长上一些，确实有些修炼心得，吾就向少主解释一下，希望能有助于少主的修炼！”
“经过长时间的修炼，吾发现这混沌造化诀博大精深、浩如烟海，它并不拘泥于功法本身而是因人而异，会因修炼者自身的条件而变化。
以吾的修炼为例，吾非人、非魂只是一个石灵，在吾修行混沌造化诀后竟是自动衍生非人、非魂的神奇功法，那是仅属于石灵的特殊功法，能直接助吾快速恢复伤势。”

content_en:
Zhang Haoyang heard the old man in white clothes, white hair and white beard ask him to call himself Shi Ling. He felt it was inappropriate and seemed to be disrespectful to Mr. Shi, so he said: "I will call you Mr. Shi from now on, okay?"
The old man in white clothes with white hair and white beard seemed to understand Zhang Haoyang's thoughts, so he smiled and nodded: "Of course!"
"Old Shi, I saw there is a fairy tower in this space. Where does this fairy tower come from?"
Zhang Haoyang asked.
After hearing this, Mr. Shi thought for a moment and said: "This Immortal Tower is extremely mysterious. I don't know its specific origin. I only know that after I was injured and fell into silence for countless years, the Immortal Tower suddenly appeared in this space. Along with the Immortal Tower, there was also a scripture."
"A passage of scripture, is it the four-cross passage?"
Zhang Haoyang asked in surprise.
Mr. Shi thought for a while and then replied: "It was the Forty-Cross Scripture that appeared in your mind at that time.
I believe that this Immortal Pagoda and the scriptures should have been put into my space by a supreme power, and I was able to recover because of the appearance of this scripture and the Immortal Pagoda.
When the young master shed his blood and was recognized by the Chaos Creation Stone, that passage of scripture automatically entered your consciousness. Obviously, you are also the one recognized by the supreme power! "
"Who has the ability to quietly put this Tower of Heaven into this space? Who taught the scriptures to you when Mr. Shi couldn't detect it? Who can teach me the scriptures when I shed my blood to recognize the master and created the fossil from chaos? What kind of existence is this?"
Zhang Haoyang asked in surprise.
"This person should be the supreme power who appeared after the war between gods and demons. He is absolutely a supreme existence. Even the demons who injured me cannot compare with him!
Shi Lao sighed.
"Old Shi, how can the Forty-Cross Scripture and the Immortal Tower help you recover from your injuries? How is your recovery from your injury now? "
Zhang Haoyang asked with concern.
"After I obtained the forty scriptures, I took the initiative to practice. After being hit by the demons, I could not recover for countless years from my injuries, but after practicing the scriptures, I slowly recovered.
The fairy tower appeared at the same time as the scripture, and the words "Chaos Creation" appeared at the end of the scripture, so I called the scripture "Chaos Creation Technique" and the fairy tower the "Chaos Tower". "
“You must have felt the magic of the scriptures in the past few days!
As for the Chaos Tower, it is also extremely magical. The Chaos Tower is divided into nine floors. There are endless treasures in each floor, and there are conditions for opening each floor.
What is even more amazing is that the time flow rate inside the tower is different from that outside the tower, and the time flow rate inside each layer of the tower is also different, which is often three times the time flow rate in the previous layer.
Taking the first floor of the tower as an example, the flow rate of time inside the tower is ten times that of the outside world. One day of cultivation inside is equivalent to ten days of practice outside. The flow rate of time in the second floor tower is thirty times that of the outside world. The flow rate of time in the third floor tower is ninety times that of the outside world. The flow of time in the fourth floor tower is 270 times that of the outside world, and so on. "
"I am currently practicing on the fourth floor, which means that one day in the outside world is already two hundred and seventy days on the fourth floor of the Chaos Tower.
Because I have been running scripture recovery on the fourth floor of the Chaos Tower, so naturally the recovery is many times faster than the outside world! "
"I see!
Is there such a treasure in the world? Mr. Shi just said that there are conditions for each level of Chaos Tower to be opened. So what are the specific conditions? Did Mr. Shi also enter the Chaos Tower after his cultivation met the conditions? Zhang Haoyang asked curiously.
“The conditions for opening the Chaos Tower are not complicated, it just requires the cultivation level of the person who opens it.
The Chaos Tower is divided into nine floors, and the opening conditions for each floor are different.
The first level requires the opener to have at least the cultivation level of Foundation Establishment Realm before it can be opened; the second level requires the opener to have at least the cultivation level of Nascent Soul Realm to open it; the third level requires the opener to have at least the cultivation level of Soul Transformation Realm to open it; the fourth level requires the opener to have at least the Mahayana Realm cultivation level to open it.Only through cultivation can it be opened.
"I am neither a human nor a soul, but a stone spirit, so I was not restricted by my cultivation when I entered the Chaos Tower.
When I entered the first floor of the Chaos Tower, I was directly transferred to the fourth floor; as for the opening conditions of the first four floors, how did I know? It's a bit embarrassing to say that I didn't experience it personally, but when the scriptures and the Chaos Tower appeared in the Chaos Creation Space, this information appeared in my memory.
Being able to put this information into my memory without anyone noticing is one of the reasons why I admire the supreme power.
Although I can enter the fourth floor of the Chaos Tower to practice, I can only practice on the fourth floor. I have the access conditions for the first four floors in my memory, but I really have no memory of the access conditions for the fifth to ninth floors, so I don’t know them! "
After Mr. Shi introduced the conditions for opening the first four floors of the Chaos Tower, he paused and said nothing more. He seemed to be deep in thought.
Zhang Haoyang knew from Shi Lao's expression that he was thinking about something, so he didn't disturb him. He waited quietly.
After pondering for a moment, Mr. Shi continued: "According to the opening conditions of the first four floors of the Chaos Tower, and based on my recovery of cultivation, even if my cultivation is only one ten thousandth, I will not be able to enter the fourth floor. Therefore, it can be concluded that there must be other unknown reasons for the inability to enter the fifth to ninth floors of the Chaos Tower.
As for the specific reason? I have been practicing and analyzing here for some years, but I still can't come to a conclusion!
Now, since you are the master of the chaotic creation space and have been recognized by the supreme power, you will surely gain some insights in your future practice, so that you are truly qualified to open subsequent floors and quickly improve your cultivation level in the subsequent floors! "
Hearing this, Zhang Haoyang nodded slightly.
"Lao Shi said just now that that passage is called Chaos Creation Technique. This technique has played a great role in my recent practice and helped me achieve breakthroughs one after another. However, I know very little about this technique. I just recite it silently. This technique will guide the true energy in my body.
Please ask Mr. Shi to explain clearly the function of this technique! "
When Mr. Shi heard Zhang Haoyang ask him about the function of the Chaos Creation Technique, he nodded slightly and replied with a smile: "I have been practicing the Chaos Creation Technique for a longer time than you, and I do have some practice experience. I will explain it to the young master, hoping it will help the young master's practice!"
"After a long period of practice, I discovered that this Chaos Creation Technique is vast, profound and vast. It is not limited to the technique itself but varies from person to person and will change according to the practitioner's own conditions.
Take my practice as an example. I am neither human nor soul, just a stone spirit. After I practiced the Chaos Creation Technique, I automatically derived a magical technique that is neither human nor soul. It is a special technique that belongs only to stone spirits and can directly help me recover from my injuries quickly. "
